name: Panel inspection-light door contact
aliases: switchrooms Switchroom lighting and access interfaces
summary: Relates the selected panel door contact to its local inspection-light control.
description: Relates the selected panel door contact to its local inspection-light control. Lighting and access interfaces coordinate the electrical-room service circuits and their supervision. Normal lighting, emergency illumination and access indication have different power sources and purposes.

In a switchroom, a normal lighting branch may be switched locally while the specified emergency luminaires remain connected to their own backed-up or integral supply. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Panel door contact” at the input and “Inspection-light request” at the output. Opening a door does not imply electrical isolation.
